subject.title: [Feature]: Support Anthropic native server-side tools (web_search, web_fetch, code_execution)

question: Should OpenClaw support Anthropic web_fetch and code_execution/PTC with allowed_callers as first-class Anthropic plugin behavior, and what opt-in, billing, security, and replay policy should govern it?
rationale: The remaining work changes provider-native execution, tool permissions, billing visibility, and transcript replay semantics, so automation should not choose the public API shape or default policy.

options.title: Design gated Anthropic server tools
options.body: Define an explicit opt-in Anthropic plugin/API surface for web_search, web_fetch, code_execution/PTC, allowed_callers, and server-result replay before implementation.

options.title: Split narrow trackers
options.body: Let narrower issues handle native web_search and advisor/server-block behavior while creating separate product decisions for web_fetch and code_execution/PTC.

options.title: Defer hosted execution
options.body: Document that OpenClaw will keep client-side fetch/search and existing code execution paths for now without Anthropic code_execution/PTC support.

recommendation.title: Design gated Anthropic server tools
recommendation.body: Define an explicit opt-in Anthropic plugin/API surface for web_search, web_fetch, code_execution/PTC, allowed_callers, and server-result replay before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the most recent visible review context and provider/plugin boundary history for the affected Anthropic surfaces.
